tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin shong lugs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so// h+ya gṝ wa na maḥ shong lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub sgom par 'dod pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes nyer gcig sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig lan gcig oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ljang khu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bsgrad pa mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu gsum kha gdangs shing skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang / zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi'i skra'i tshangs skud dang / khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskum zhing / g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin tshon gang bas go mtshams med par gtams pa rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrogs shing me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul bsreg par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ tig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa mā ya dzaḥ sa mā ya bzlog sa mā ya bh+yoḥ sa mā ya gtubs/ sa mā ya byer/ sa mā ya rbad/ sa mā ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur tu bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/ //ces tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung sor bzhag la skyabs sems tshad med rnams nag 'gros su sa skya pa kun blos bkod pa'o//
